scientific_target: survey-recorded annual colonisation of a water-vole habitat patch recorded unoccupied in the preceding year

allowed_at_gate0: OSF file names, paths, IDs, sizes and hashes exposed by metadata
forbidden_at_gate0: coordinates co-located only inside response rows

gate0_pass_if: stable public OSF project metadata is reproducible
complete 110-patch node registry and geometry/distance representation are identifiable independently of response rows
prospective_estimability_boundary: Published rates alone are not treated as event/non-event count lower bounds. A PASS requires published/documented aggregate counts or other response-blind count bounds for the frozen calibration and heldout blocks.
no_rescue: Do not open occupancy rows to learn eligibility counts, and do not reuse the stopped 1999-2005 69-patch response as a predictor or validation outcome.
